source.title: Competitor likely received a misscramble on a National Record attempt
source.content:
A competitor had broken the National Record single in Skewb, which was significantly faster than their average in the event. Due to the cheering and excitement, the delegate and competitor were only able to meet at the end of the competition to verify the scramble. After multiple attempts, the competitor claimed that they were unfamiliar with the true scramble (that they were supposed to receive)

The competitor was then encouraged to try out the scramble at home once scrambles were posted, but the competitor asked for help in reading the notation, which lead to suspicion regarding the validity of the record. The delegate also noticed that the scorecard for the record-breaking attempt was not signed by the scrambler. Due to all of these factors, there was high suspicion that the cube was incorrectly scrambled.

The WRC agreed that the cube was likely not scrambled correctly, and ruled that the incident should be handled assuming that the scramble was not correct. Following [11i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1), since no extra attempt was given at the competition, the attempt was ruled as a DNS. 

In order to reduce the penalties that must be given to competitors who receive incorrectly scrambled puzzles, the WRC recommends the following:
- Competitors who are expected to meet the crieteria in [11i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1) should have their scrambles checked by a second scrambler ([11i1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1+))
- Competitors who achieve results meeting the criteria in [11i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1) should have their scrambles checked as soon as is reasonable.
- Provisional extras can be given if the resolution to an incident is unclear in the moment. ([11e+++++](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11e+++++))

translation.title: 国家纪录尝试很可能使用了错误打乱
translation.content:
一名选手打破 Skewb 单次国家纪录，远快于其平均水平。因欢呼和兴奋，代表与选手直到比赛结束才核查打乱。多次尝试后，选手称不熟悉本应收到的正确打乱。

代表鼓励其待打乱公布后在家试做，但选手请求帮助理解记号，引发对纪录有效性的疑虑。代表还发现该次成绩单缺少打乱员签名。这些因素使人高度怀疑打乱不正确。

WRC 同意打乱很可能有误，决定按错误打乱处理。由于现场没有给予额外尝试，依据 [11i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1) 判为 DNS。

为减少因收到错误打乱而必须对选手施加的后果，WRC 建议：
- 预计可能达到 [11i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1) 标准的选手，打乱应由第二名打乱员复核（[11i1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1+)）；
- 成绩达到 [11i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11i1) 标准后，应在合理可行时尽快核查打乱；
- 若当时无法明确裁定，可以给予暂定的额外尝试（[11e+++++](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#11e+++++)）。
